title: Nuclear Reactor Pressure Vessel (RPV) Bolted Closure Head Joint
source: Abaqus 2025 Example Problems - Axisymmetric and 3D Analysis of a Reactor Pressure Vessel Bolted Closure Joint; ASME BPVC Section III Division 1 Subsection NB
problem_description: Massive pressurized water reactor (PWR) vessel closure joint featuring 54 large-diameter preloaded stud bolts and a metallic double-cone seal ring subjected to simultaneous bolt pre-tensioning and high-pressure operational loading (17.5 MPa).

vessel_and_head_forging.material_name: ASME SA-508 Grade 3 Class 1 Low Alloy Forging Steel

stud_bolt_alloy.material_name: ASME SA-540 Grade B23/B24 High Strength Stud Alloy

loading_procedure.description: Uniform hydraulic tensioning of 54 stud bolts to 6.50 MN per bolt (351 MN total pre-clamp load) to seat the double-cone metallic gasket.
loading_procedure.boundary: Rigid vertical restraint at vessel support skirt ledge; circumferential symmetry

loading_procedure.description: Lock stud bolt elongation (LOCK_LENGTH) and apply design operational pressure of 17.5 MPa (175 bar) to the inner cavity and closure head dome. Baseline end-thrust of 219.91 MN is integrated across vessel inner radius Ri = 2000 mm; with fluid penetration up to seal inner radius R_seal = 2060 mm, effective thrust reaches 233.30 MN.
